    Achievements

    🔄 Habits Management

    Track your daily habits and achieve your goals

    📖 How does the habits system work?

    • Select a task and click "Activate Habit" to link it to a new habit
    • When completing the task, "Success" is automatically recorded in the habit
    • When failing the task, "Failure" is automatically recorded in the habit
    • Calendar shows your progress history: 🟢 Success | 🔴 Failure | ⬜ Not recorded
    • Each habit is independent with its own record

      Quick Start

      🚀 Getting Started Steps

      1. Start by setting your goals from the "Goals" section
      2. Add your daily and recurring tasks from the "Tasks" section
      3. Track your progress from the home page
      4. Earn XP and gold by completing tasks

      Tasks Guide

      ✅ Complete Task

      Click the "Complete" button to record task completion and earn points and gold

      ❌ Fail Task

      Use the "Fail" button if you couldn't complete the task to track challenges

      ✏️ Edit Task

      You can edit any task details using the edit button

      🗑️ Delete Task

      Delete tasks you no longer need permanently

      System Features

      📊 Level System

      Earn XP to level up and unlock new achievements

      💰 Gold System

      Collect gold from completing tasks to measure your virtual wealth

      📈 Statistics

      Track your progress in various areas like fitness, learning, and work

      🏆 Achievements

      Unlock achievement badges by completing various challenges and milestones

      Tips and Tricks

      💡 Tips for Success

      • Start Small: Make your tasks achievable at first
      • Be Consistent: Small regular effort is better than sporadic big efforts
      • Track Your Progress: Review the log and statistics regularly
      • Celebrate Achievements: Appreciating small wins is important
      • Learn from Failure: Use the "Fail" button to analyze challenges

      Complete Beginner's Guide

      🎯 What is Solo Leveling?

      Solo Leveling is a task and personal goal management app inspired by RPG games. It turns your daily life into a fun game where you earn XP and gold when completing tasks and goals.

      🚀 Detailed Getting Started Steps:

      1. Step 1 - Understanding the Interface:
        • The home page displays your current level, XP, and gold
        • The top menu contains all sections (Tasks, Goals, Store, etc.)
        • Each section has a specific function to organize your life
      2. Step 2 - Setting Your First Goal:
        • Go to the "Goals" section from the top menu
        • Click on "Add New Goal"
        • Write a realistic goal like "Read one book monthly"
        • Set the start and end dates
        • Choose an appropriate category for the goal
      3. Step 3 - Adding Daily Tasks:
        • Go to the "Tasks" section
        • Add simple tasks like "Drink 8 glasses of water"
        • Set the task type (daily, weekly, monthly)
        • Choose appropriate rewards (XP and gold)
      4. Step 4 - Starting the Application:
        • Start by completing simple tasks first
        • Click "Complete" when you finish any task
        • Watch your level and XP increase
        • Use gold to buy themes from the store

      • Charts showing your performance evolution
      • Compare performance across periods

      Benefit: Analyze your strengths and weaknesses

      • Consistency and regularity achievements

      Motivation: Achievements give you motivation to continue

      Statistics & Data Guide

      📈 Understanding Statistics

      Key Metrics:

      • Completion Rate: Ratio of completed tasks to total tasks
      • Streaks: Number of consecutive days completing tasks
      • XP: Total points earned
      • Collected Gold: Total virtual wealth

      📊 Reading Charts

      Types of Charts:

      • Bar Chart: Shows performance over periods
      • Pie Chart: Shows task distribution by categories
      • Line Chart: Tracks progress over time
      • Heat Grid: Shows activity density

      🎯 Using Data

      How to Benefit:

      • Identify your most productive times
      • Discover categories that need improvement
      • Track your monthly performance evolution
      • Adjust your goals based on results

      Frequently Asked Questions

      ❓ Important Q&A

      Q: How do I level up quickly?

      A: Focus on daily and simple tasks first. Consistency is more important than quantity. Complete your tasks daily even if they're simple.

      Q: What if I fail to complete a task?

      A: No problem! Click the "Fail" button to record the attempt. Learning from failure is part of development. Analyze the reason for failure and adjust the task.

      Q: How long do I need to see results?

      A: You'll feel improvement within a week of regular use. The real impact shows after a month of commitment.

      Q: Can I edit tasks after creating them?

      A: Yes! You can edit any task at any time. Click the edit button next to the task and change what you want.

      Q: How do I stay motivated?

      A: Make tasks simple and achievable. Celebrate small achievements. Use themes and rewards. Review your progress in statistics.

      Q: Is my data stored safely?

      A: Yes, all your data is stored locally in your browser and completely safe. No information is sent to external servers.

      Troubleshooting Guide

      🔧 Common Problems and Solutions

      Problem: Tasks don't appear

      Solution: Make sure you're in the correct tasks section, and refresh the page if necessary.

      Problem: Progress doesn't save

      Solution: Make sure JavaScript and local storage are enabled in your browser.

      Problem: Theme doesn't change

      Solution: Make sure to buy the theme first, then click "Apply" in the collection section.

      Problem: Statistics are incorrect

      Solution: Make sure to complete tasks correctly. You may need to reload the page.

      💾 Data Backup

      How to preserve your data:

      • Use the data export feature in settings
      • Save the backup file in a safe place
      • You can import data at any time
      • Copy the link and save it as reference

      Tip: Make a weekly backup to preserve your progress!

      Advanced Tips for Experts

      🎖️ How to Become a System Expert

      ⚡ Optimizing Performance
      • Group similar tasks in one category
      • Use recurring tasks for daily habits
      • Set rewards matching task difficulty
      • Review statistics weekly for improvement
      🏆 Success Strategies
      • Start with only 3-5 daily tasks
      • Increase difficulty gradually over time
      • Celebrate every achievement no matter how small
      • Use themes to renew enthusiasm
      💡 Smart Tricks
      • Stacking Technique: Link new tasks to existing habits (like reading 10 minutes after drinking coffee)
      • Two-Minute Rule: Make the start of any difficult task just two minutes to break the starting barrier
      • Conditional Rewards: Link real-life rewards to system achievements
      • Reverse Tracking: Sometimes record tasks after completing them to boost confidence
      • Focus Sessions: Combine similar tasks in one session to increase efficiency
